description: Wave multiplier making eight delayed copies of one input and summing them into a running mix, with each copy also available on its own

params.text: Scales that delayed copy before it is added into the running mix, 0 to 1
Sets the delay of that copy, 0 for none and 1 for a tenth of a second
Scales the input before it reaches the eight delay lines, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Shifts the delay of that copy, 10V adding the whole 0 to 1 span to its SHIFT knob and -10V taking it away
The signal copied into all eight delay lines

outputs.text: The running mix of the delayed copies, summed down to and including that one
A polyphonic cable of eight channels, each carrying one delayed copy on its own after its LEVEL knob, with nothing summed
The full mix of all eight delayed copies
